lines: Keep the secret of articulating the
creation-dissolution seed; impress the concept. And in
these rests, each has five states, by the depth
l4.sanskrit_cite: tad eva sṛṣṭisaṃhārabījoccāraṇarahasyam anusaṃdadhat vikalpaṃ saṃskuryāt āsu ca viśrāntiṣu pratyekaṃ pañca avasthā bhavanti praveśatāratamyāt
